heading_en: Exposures to Subordinated Debt and Other Capital Instruments
summary_ja: 次条から第四十三条の三の二までに該当しない劣後債権その他資本性証券のエクスポージャーのリスク・ウェイトを百五十パーセントとする。
summary_en: Subordinated debt and other capital instruments not covered by Articles 38 to 43-3-2 take 150%.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 22 through the preceding Article, the risk weight of exposures relating to subordinated debt and other capital instruments that do not fall under any of the provisions of the following Article through Article 43-3-2 shall be 150%.
